mapper.sql: id, task_id, plan_version_id, step_seq, device_agent_id, command_id, step_status, retry_count, execution_result, reason_code, output_params, dispatched_at, feedback_at, rejected_agent_ids, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task_step_assignments WHERE plan_version_id = #{planVersionId} ORDER BY step_seq ASC

SELECT a.id, a.task_id, a.plan_version_id, a.step_seq, a.device_agent_id, a.command_id, a.step_status, a.retry_count, a.execution_result, a.reason_code, a.output_params, a.dispatched_at, a.feedback_at, a.rejected_agent_ids, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM task_step_assignments a JOIN tasks t ON t.id = a.task_id WHERE a.device_agent_id = #{agentId} AND t.is_dry_run = FALSE AND t.status IN ('PENDING_ASSIGNMENT', 'DOWNGRADING', 'EXECUTING') AND a.step_status IN ('PENDING_ASSIGNMENT', 'EXECUTING') ORDER BY a.task_id, a.step_seq
SELECT FROM task_step_assignments WHERE plan_version_id = #{planVersionId} AND step_seq = #{stepSeq}
SELECT FROM task_step_assignments WHERE step_status = #{stepStatus} AND dispatched_at < #{threshold}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_step_assignments (task_id, plan_version_id, step_seq, device_agent_id, command_id, step_status, retry_count, execution_result, reason_code, output_params, dispatched_at, feedback_at, rejected_agent_ids, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{planVersionId}, #{stepSeq}, #{deviceAgentId}, #{commandId}, #{stepStatus}, #{retryCount}, #{executionResult}, #{reasonCode}, #{outputParams}::json, #{dispatchedAt}, #{feedbackAt}, #{rejectedAgentIds}::json, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE task_step_assignments SET device_agent_id = #{deviceAgentId}, command_id = #{commandId}, step_status = #{stepStatus}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, execution_result = #{executionResult}, reason_code = #{reasonCode}, output_params = #{outputParams}::json, dispatched_at = #{dispatchedAt}, feedback_at = #{feedbackAt}, rejected_agent_ids = #{rejectedAgentIds}::json, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
